classification.difficultyReason: Students compare consecutive equations to infer a common operation on both sides, distinguishing scaling from addition and reconstructing compound changes such as adding 3n−4. All intermediate equations are supplied, so no overall solution strategy is needed.

content.prompt: For each equivalent equation, indicate the operation that has been done to both sides.

answer.short: Top to bottom, in both boxes: $+10$; $\times2$; $+n$; $-4n$; $+3n-4$; $-5n-1$; $+n$; $+4n-5$; $\div2$.

inlines.text: Apply each operation to both sides and simplify.
